turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How may I help you today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been having, uhh, like, nasal congestion and I've been sneezing a lot, over these last couple of days, and I've also been having a sore throat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh no, when did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So the store throat started like 2 days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and since then you've developed this nasal congestion and sneezing as well?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah exactly, it started a bit afterwards or around the same time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, alright and have you have any other symptoms? Do you have a fever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have any difficulties swallowing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, Yeah, it has been a bit sore when eating food, but it hasn't been so painful to prevent me from eating.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have a cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had a cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and do you have a runny nose, any discharge?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, Yeah, there's been a little bit of a like watery discharge, my nose has been running.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any ear pain or any pain in your cheeks or your head when you're bending over, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, now that you say it, yeah, when I was bending over to put my shoes on, I felt just a bit of pressure on the front of my face.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you haven't been feeling feverish or having having any chills, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any fatigue, malaise, any aches or pains?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh. no, I felt OK, that way, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK, Have you been up to date with your immunizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and just have a couple more questions just to see if anything else is going on. Do you have a headache at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, I've had a headache, since this morning. It's pretty mild. It feels like my head is squeezing. I think, uh, I've had headaches like this before, if I don't sleep well or dehydrated.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you more stressed out than usual? Do you have exams or anything going on right now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, schools been pretty good. We've been doing a lot of stuff online, so uh, yeah that's been good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any, uh, do you find that your eyes are runny or red or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I haven't noticed anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright and any difficulties breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, any pain in your belly or any problems with your bowel movements?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any urinary symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright good. So can you tell me if you have any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I had dermatitis when I was a kid but I haven't had any issues since. I remember using some creams for that but I haven't needed to use them recently.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any medications that you're taking currently, including over the counter pills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't take anything currently.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, did you take any medications, to reduce the symptoms that you're having, the headache or the sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh sorry, yeah I used some Advil this morning. I think it was 400 milligrams.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, to cats.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you been around a cat recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, we used to have a cat, but unfortunately we were unable to keep it because allergies were so bad.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, do you have any environmental allergies at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, yeah sometimes in the spring or fall I can get like itchy eyes and a runny nose, so that's why I didn't think much about the runny nose at first, but with a sore throat and, been sneezing more, I thought to come in.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK. So in terms of your, uh, so general information. Do you live alone or do you live with your parents or anyone else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I live with my mom, dad and a younger brother.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and are you currently working or going to school?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I'm finishing up Grade 8 and we're doing the courses online.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, great so, have you spent any time outdoors or spent any time with people who you think might be sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, I've played some, like, basketball outside with one of the neighbors, but I don't think he's been sick.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright, and have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, alright, and do you, uhm, have you had these symptoms anytime recently before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I can think of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, have you been tested for covid anytime in the recent past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you taken any antibiotics recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright well it sounds like you're probably having just a common cold, likely viral. So, and seeing that it's only been two days, have your symptoms gotten better or worse in the past couple of days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: They've gotten worse since it's started.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK, well, it's only been two days so far, let's just keep an eye on your symptoms and see how you're doing. It might also be a good idea just to get a covid swab done, and if your symptoms continue to worsen, give me a call again and we can talk about it a little bit more and see if maybe a bacterial infection or if there's something else that's going on. You don't have any difficulties breathing, do you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, OK, alright umm, we'll do a physical exam and then chat a little bit more after.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, thank you.
